name: Tom Olmstead
occupation: Former aviation professional; in a 2024 campaign announcement he said he lost a 25-year aviation career in 2021, which he attributed to COVID mandates
background: Tom Olmstead of Basin ran in the 2024 Republican primary for Senate District 20 and lost. Cowboy State Daily reported in June 2024 that the Basin resident was running after moving to Wyoming from Colorado three years earlier.

Local announcements in the Thermopolis Independent Record and Basin Republican Rustler in March 2024 said he lived in Basin with his wife of 20 years and their two sons. In his announcement he described himself as “more of a patriot than a politician.” Already-sourced material on this record also states that he is a former aviation professional who said in that announcement that he lost a 25-year aviation career in 2021, which he attributed to COVID mandates.
